title: Sleeping In
description: Grandma happily shares on the phone that her grandson has no football game this Sunday, which means she gets to sleep in.
alt: In a cozy living room, Grandma sits curled up on a couch in burgundy and floral pajamas, smiling with a phone to her ear. She says, 'My grandson doesn’t have a football game this Sunday…' followed by, '…so Grandma gets to sleep in!'
